title: AI Senior Business System Consultant
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
As part of AbbVie’s Business Technology Solutions (BTS) team, R&D Global Therapeutics is dedicated to building and deploying scalable, business-driven Artificial Intelligence (AI) Applications. We are seeking an innovative and highly skilled AI Senior Business Systems Consultant, to lead the strategy and execution of automation initiatives, with an emphasis on AI safety solutions.
In this role, you will manage the deployment of both AI and traditional products and solutions. You will work closely with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to identify, select, and consult on the appropriate AI technologies to be deployed. Proactively seeks out strategic business opportunities with high-level business unit executives. Provide advice, assistance and leadership in any area associated with the planning, procurement, provision, delivery, management, maintenance, and effective business use of information systems for a business area. Analyze business processes; elicit, analyze, and document business requirements; identify alternative solutions, assess feasibility, and make recommendations typically seeking to exploit and leverage new or existing technology components. Translate business requirements into functional requirements; perform data and process modeling; manage change; and lead, coordinate/perform testing, verification, and validation of requirements.​
Responsibilities:
Work with senior business unit clients to understand specific business processes, business drivers, and business strategy across multiple functions; Personally, or through indirect team management identify, prioritize and communicate resulting needs and opportunities for business process improvement that can be enabled via technology; Use consulting skills and expertise to translate business requirements to BTS and functional requirements to the domain.
Investigate and understand capabilities of existing systems and technologies already in use across the business area and similar and interconnected business areas in AbbVie and investigate available technologies applied to this business area in industry; identify information required to support the business strategy and lead the development of appropriate information management strategies and developing them as an integrated part of the business strategy.
Define needed human and technology capabilities contributing to and helping to build necessary training. Mentor, Identify, communicate, and actively participate in opportunities to improve process and/or technology. These may include business process outsourcing, application development, or adopting business process management (BPM) practices.
Accountable for the creation and further refinement of project requirements and for BTO Demand initiation and coordination.  Anticipate project/program risks, define mitigation plans, and work with teams to implement. Working with business partners and BTO management, responsible for resolving changes to scope, issues, and risks that will affect multiple and/or large-scale projects/programs.
Simultaneously consider objectives of multiple functions. Measure performance to ensure the project is progressing as compared to original plan and budget. Accountable for the accuracy of the fit of the proposed business process improvements and the technical solution to the business need and the information upon which the business justification and prioritization decisions are made. Understand and execute AbbVie's vision, goals and strategies and use this understanding to broker services.
As an individual contributor adeptly navigate cross-functional and highly matrixed teams through indirect authority. Has defined authority and responsibility for a significant area of work, including technical, financial, and quality aspects, and delegate assignments across multiple and/or large-scale projects/programs. Accountable for actions and decisions taken by self and project teams.
Anticipate and respond to current and emerging business needs and evaluate alternative IT solutions using standard information systems methodologies and best practices. Determine necessary resources to ensure program and business needs are addressed through proactive priority management with business leaders. Manage, motivate, and mentor cross-functional and enterprise project teams. Work with governance bodies to ensure alignment.
Build collaborative relationships and effectively interact frequently with business and/or technology senior leaders. Act as a liaison and business process expert to IT organizations to ensure successful implementation. Serve as a source of information to the service organizations on the business drivers, processes, and organization structure and dynamics of multiple business areas. Subject matter expert in their technology and/or functional domain.
Interact well with diverse groups within function and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external collaborators. Consistently demonstrate AbbVie's Ways of Working and Leadership Attributes including an enterprise mindset and people leadership. Serve as a mentor to develop and recognize talent. Ability to communicate problems in terms that are understandable to BTS Leadership and end users at all levels.
Required:
Bachelor's Degree with 8 years of experience; Master's Degree with 7 years of experience; PhD with 3 years of experience.
3+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, or similar role in a technical environment or product management.
Strong leadership and team management abilities, with experience leading cross-functional teams.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Proven track record of managing the development and launch of successful software products.
Knowledge of software development best practices.
Proficiency in Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence).
Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.
Preferred:
​ Understanding of Large Language Models, Generative AI, traditional AI and how to apply them and select for best fit.
​Experience working in the Life Sciences industry.
​Experience with GxP validated systems​.
Technical Writing Skills

Working across R&D, Commercial, Pipeline Commercial Strategy, CBSO, BD Finance, and other partners, this role sits at the intersection of scientific innovation and commercial strategy and directly supports decisions that influence AbbVie’s future portfolio.
Success requires strong forecasting and commercial analytics expertise, rigorous assumption development, clear executive communication, and the ability to influence across a matrixed organization. For the right candidate, the role offers meaningful growth through exposure to senior leaders, enterprise-wide relationships, and deeper understanding of both R&D and Commercial strategy.
This role reports to the Director, Global Business Development Forecasting.
Responsibilities
Lead commercial forecasting, market assessments, scenario analyses, and commercial P&Ls for BD opportunities, balancing analytical rigor with timely decision support in a fast-paced environment.
Develop patient-based forecast models, pressure-test assumptions, and apply primary research, secondary data, epidemiology, competitive intelligence, market access input, and expert perspectives to build a well-supported commercial view.
Partner broadly across BD, PCS, finance, market access, epidemiology, marketing analytics, and senior leadership to align assumptions, clarify risks and opportunities, and ensure commercial perspectives are reflected in deal valuation and governance discussions.
Translate complex analyses into clear recommendations, executive-ready narratives, and decision options for senior leaders and governance forums, facilitating productive discussion around uncertainty, trade-offs, and strategic implications.
Advance BD forecasting capabilities by sharing best practices, improving tools and processes, and helping create faster, more consistent, and audit-ready ways of working.

Business and therapeutic area knowledge:  Experience supporting strategic decision making in specialized therapeutic areas such as Neuroscience, Immunology, Oncology, or other complex markets is preferred; ability to apply data, assumptions, and market context effectively is critical.
Communication and influence:  Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to tailor messages by audience, translate complex quantitative analyses into recommendations and decision options, and influence stakeholders across functions and cultures without direct authority.

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Purpose
The Associate Director, Medical Affairs + Health Impact (MHI) Therapeutic Area Communications, develops and executes an integrated communications strategy spanning Medical Affairs and Value & Evidence within a designated therapeutic area. The Associate Director amplifies MHI’s contributions and supporting evidence to strengthen pipeline and brand narratives, demonstrating how scientific innovation addresses unmet need, closes care gaps, elevates the standard of care and delivers value across the healthcare system.
The role partners with Pipeline & External Innovation Communications, Commercial Communications, Global Patient & Community Partnerships and other cross-functional stakeholders to coordinate plans and deliver on shared priorities. The role reports to the Director of MHI Communications within the Corporate Affairs organization.
Responsibilities
Serve as communications partner with the MHI therapeutic area vice president and leadership team.
Develop communications strategies that amplify MHI-generated evidence, medical education and capabilities to strengthen pipeline and brand narratives and demonstrate how scientific innovation addresses unmet needs, closes care gaps, elevates the standard of care and delivers value across the healthcare system.
Develop and deliver thought leadership for the MHI therapeutic area vice president across LinkedIn, congresses, conferences, external events and leadership forums.
Represent MHI on the therapeutic area Communications Council, congress planning team and business unit vice president leadership team, connecting MHI work with pipeline and commercial communications strategies and coordinating aligned execution.
Develop communications that increase internal visibility and understanding of MHI’s value, work and contributions among AbbVie employees and field teams.
Demonstrate understanding of the external environment, stakeholder insights and performance data; track objectives and KPIs; report results; and recommend improvements to plans and execution.
Support cross-R&D initiatives that elevate MHI’s contributions, as well as KOL engagement opportunities to advance MHI leadership visibility and communications objectives.
Manage workstreams, agency partners, budgets, timelines and review processes, contributing to annual planning, prioritization and continuous improvement across the R&D Communications operating model.
Ensure content is developed in compliance with applicable corporate, legal, regulatory and medical review requirements.
Bachelor’s degree required.
Minimum of 5+ years of experience in integrated communications, preferably in the healthcare, biotechnology or pharmaceutical industries.
Solid understanding of the drug development lifecycle and the broader life sciences industry.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex scientific, medical and value evidence into clear, compelling communications that strengthen pipeline and brand stories for diverse audiences.
Proven track record of translating communications strategy into high-quality tactical execution, delivering measurable outcomes and refining plans based on insights and impact.
Strong project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives, coordinate cross-functional partners and deliver results in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
Excellent verbal, written and visual storytelling skills, with strong attention to detail and sound communications judgment.
Collaborative, proactive and solutions-oriented, with strong business acumen, enterprise thinking and comfort navigating ambiguity.
Strong understanding of emerging communications trends, digital channels, senior leader visibility strategies and AI-enabled ways of working.

Purpose
AbbVie’s Corporate Communications team is responsible for enterprise internal and external communications to enhance and protect AbbVie’s reputation. The team is seeking an experienced communications professional to join the Global Operations Communications team as Associate Director, Operations Communications.
Reporting to the Director, Global Operations Communications, this role will serve as a key strategic execution partner within the Global Operations Communications team, with primary responsibility for supporting communications across AbbVie’s Supply Chain and Quality organizations and additional flexible communications support across functions for broader Operations priorities.
The Associate Director will lead day-to-day communications planning and execution, independently manage significant communications workstreams, and develop high-quality executive and employee communications that advance business priorities.
The successful candidate will combine strong strategic thinking with exceptional execution. They will be expected to quickly understand complex business priorities, translate them into clear and compelling communications, manage multiple initiatives independently and drive work from strategy through delivery in a complex, global organization.
Responsibilities
Serve as a key strategic execution partner for Supply Chain and Quality communications, leading day-to-day communications planning and delivery and independently managing significant workstreams in partnership with the Director, Global Operations Communications.
Develop high-quality executive communications, including presentations, speeches, talking points, employee messages, organizational announcements, videos and other leadership communications.
Develop content across a range of internal and external Operations communications channels, including digital platforms, presentations, video, social media and other storytelling vehicles.
Provide communications planning and execution support for broader Operations-wide priorities and initiatives, including employee meetings and leadership forums.
Collaborate across the Global Operations Communications team and broader Corporate Communications organization to ensure alignment, share best practices and identify opportunities to amplify Operations stories.
Manage external agency and vendor support as needed, providing clear direction and oversight to ensure high-quality execution.
Manage multiple complex projects simultaneously, exercising strong judgment and prioritization while maintaining a high standard of quality, accuracy and attention to detail.
Use communications insights, feedback and available measurement to continuously strengthen communications approaches and improve effectiveness.
Minimum of 10 years of integrated communications experience required, including at least five years in a complex corporate communications or agency environment.
Bachelor’s degree in communications, business, journalism, marketing, public relations or related field.
Significant progressive experience in corporate communications, employee communications, executive communications or a related discipline.
Experience with content management platforms and design tools, as well as working with external developers and vendors.
Demonstrated experience developing and executing strategic communications programs that advance business priorities.
Experience developing executive-level communications and working directly with senior leaders and stakeholders.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
Strategic thinker and exceptional executor, with the ability to move seamlessly between big-picture communications planning and hands-on delivery.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills and demonstrated ability to translate complex subjects into clear, concise and compelling communications.
Strong executive presence and ability to build credibility and effective working relationships with senior leaders and key stakeholders.
High degree of ownership, initiative and independence, with the judgment to move work forward while knowing when to engage others.
Strong project management and prioritization skills, particularly in a fast-paced environment with multiple competing priorities.
Ability to work effectively across functions and navigate a highly matrixed global organization through strong relationship management, collaboration and influence.
Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed to support business priorities, key meetings and events.

The Associate Director, Statistics provides statistical leadership for clinical development and life-cycle management strategies for assigned projects. Specific areas of work may include clinical trials, patient safety, and global medical affairs. The Associate Director works in partnership with experts in multiple disciplines to advance medicines to our patients.
Responsibilities:
Provide statistical support for one or more clinical development projects through own efforts or those of a team. Lead/develop statistical strategy for project development and regulatory submission.
Provide statistical leadership for design, analysis and reporting for clinical or other scientific research programs. Independently develop protocols and statistical analysis plans.
Represent function/department on project team(s) to provide statistical input to compound/drug development and drive alignment with functional management. Partner with other functions (Clinical, Regulatory, Patient Safety, or GMA) to create development strategies for assigned projects.
Demonstrate extensive understanding of statistical concepts and methodology. Propose novel statistical methodological approaches to design of scientific studies. Provide sufficient detail to allow programming implementation. Ensure that all statistical analyses specified in scientific protocols and analysis plans are conducted appropriately.
Train and mentor staff on statistical methodology and operations. May supervise contract statisticians or junior statisticians. Gain expertise in innovative statistical methods. Assist functional leaders in recruiting qualified personnel and arranging training opportunities for professional development of staff.
Develop strategy for data presentation and inference. Ensure appropriate interpretation of statistical deliverables in collaboration with other functions. Collaborate in publication of scientific research. Ensure accuracy and internal consistency of reports and publications, including tables, listings, and figures.
Act as the liaison for statistical issues on AbbVie collaborative studies with CROs, academic institutions, government agencies, steering and/or data monitoring committees, joint ventures or licensing collaborators. Build external scientific connections which foster professional development and promote the reputation of the Statistics department.
Ensure that all applicable regulatory requirements for work processes are met. Critically review regulatory submission documents. Participate in discussions with regulatory agencies as needed. Validate external statistical software to ensure compliance with SOPs and regulatory requirements.
Minimum Qualifications:
MS (with 10+ years of experience) or PhD (with 6+ years of experience) in Statistics, Biostatistics, or a highly related field.
Demonstrated depth in statistical methodology and its practical application, with the judgment to identify complex data, design, or analytical issues and develop effective solutions. Knows when to draw on additional expertise and collaborates effectively to resolve challenges.
Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to explain complex statistical concepts and recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
Proven ability to independently lead work across competing priorities, manage project timelines, and deliver high-quality, fit-for-purpose outputs.
Able to build strong relationships with peers and cross-functional partners to achieve higher performance. Highly motivated to drive innovation by raising the bar and challenging the status quo
Have strong leadership skills and experience in working/managing cross-cultural or oversea teams
Pharmaceutical or related industry knowledge required, including experience and understanding of drug development and life-cycle management in the regulated environment.
Clinical Trial Experience
Preferred Qualifications:
Immunology clinical trial experience
PhD in statistics or biostatistics

Manufacturing equipment and processes require a high degree of specialized attention around the clock. The primary objective is to maximize efficiency and prevent any interruption of production by achieving control over the systems the manufacturing cycle depends on. Primarily these systems include facility, equipment, utility, and controls. These systems are maintained and continually improved by Engineer Technician I’s. They also contribute to the design of products and processes. The role will provide technical support for industrial automation and controls systems, including PLCs, HMIs, Vision systems, and associated manufacturing equipment, with a focus on troubleshooting and minimizing production downtime.
Responsibilities
Works in an independent manner under the guidance of a supervisor or technical lead. Assignments have clear and specified objectives and require the investigation of a limited number of variables. Examples of supporting assignments include: system maintenance, equipment or process design and development, validation of equipment, materials and processes, preparation of specifications.

Provides technical service. Daily monitoring and troubleshooting of assigned systems. Troubleshoots industrial automation and control systems, including PLCs, HMIs, sensors, instrumentation, Vision systems, and associated equipment. Exchanges information with project team members, designers, management, and other engineering or production personnel. Delivers recommendations and suggestions to project team members and management within the department.
Provides limited technical assistance and information to production, engineering groups and outside consultants, contractors, and various departments within the Company.
Participates and/or assists engineers in the design of process equipment or systems for optimal performance. Assists in the start-up of new and troubleshoots existing facilities/equipment to ensure optimal operation and performance. Supports the installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of automation and controls equipment and systems.
Identifies issues and implements troubleshooting techniques necessary to avoid production downtime. Closely monitors systems as assigned for potential issues and/or improvements. Utilizes PLC diagnostics, HMI information, electrical drawings, and equipment documentation to identify and resolve automation-related issues.
Responds to requests, evaluates problems, determines causes and communicates and implements solutions in the most efficient manner.
High School/GED is required. Technical school completion/certification preferred.
At least 5 years prior technical experience in area(s) of specialty with basic knowledge of systems described.
Working knowledge of PLC-based control systems, preferably Allen-Bradley/Rockwell Automation or Siemens platforms.
Basic understanding of Vision systems, preferably Cognex or Keyence platforms.
Basic understanding of PC hardware, Windows operating systems, Ignition, and industrial network communications used in manufacturing and automation systems.
Ability to use PLC diagnostics, HMI information, electrical schematics, and technical documentation to identify and troubleshoot equipment issues.
Knowledge of basic regulatory requirements.

description:

Purpose:
AbbVie is seeking a highly motivated, scientifically rigorous and collaborative postdoctoral fellow to join the Materials Science & Characterization Team in PDST / PPG Analytical to advance AI-enabled, multimodal characterization of targeted lipid nanoparticles (tLNPs). This position offers an opportunity to lead the generation, integration, and curation of an analytical dataset using experimental characterization data generated internally and data received predominantly from external laboratories and contract research organizations (CROs). During the first half of the appointment, the primary focus will be on analytical data generation, data quality assessment, standardization, and curation; during the second half, the fellow will increasingly apply feature extraction and interpretable statistical and machine-learning analyses to identify attributes associated with particle heterogeneity, stability, product quality, and functional performance in support of tLNP development.  The successful candidate will design and execute experiments, analyze and interpret data, collaborate with multidisciplinary partners, and contribute to scientific publications, presentations, and internal knowledge sharing. The goal of this position is to generate new insights, methods, or capabilities that advance Product Development Science & Technology priorities and support innovation of future commercial delivery approaches for Oncology and Immunology Therapies.

Own and execute fit-for-purpose tLNP analytical-data programs, incorporating internally generated data and analytical data received predominantly from external laboratories and CROs, in alignment with project objectives.
Design rigorous experiments and analytical workflows ; define data-transfer, quality-assessment, and documentation requirements for internally and externally generated datasets; and establish consistent reporting standards to support high-quality tLNP development and decision-making.
Define and manage batch metadata, sampling strategies, sample-tracking requirements, and provenance for samples and data generated internally or received from external partners
Build, integrate curate, and maintain validated multimodal characterization datasets across analytical platforms, with an initial emphasis on data generation, quality assessment, harmonization, and curation.
Analyze and harmonize quantitative features related to particle size, morphology, aggregation, thermal behavior, spectroscopy, encapsulation, and accessibility.
Following establishment of a sufficiently curated analytical dataset, develop and apply interpretable statistical, computational, and machine-learning approaches to identify quality-relevant attributes, fingerprint batches, assess heterogeneity and stability risks, and evaluate structure–function relationships.
Troubleshoot technical challenges; assess the quality, completeness, and interpretability of internally and externally generated analytical data; recommend alternative approaches; and design targeted follow-up experiments or analyses.
Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams by communicating scientific plans, progress, results, and recommendations;
Contribute to publications, abstracts, presentations, patent filings, and other scientific communications;
Maintain awareness of relevant scientific literature, emerging technologies, and external developments in the field.
Ensure work is conducted in alignment with applicable safety, quality, compliance, and documentation expectations.
PhD in materials science, chemical engineering, biophysics, physical chemistry, analytical chemistry or related discipline.
Experience with tLNP formulation, manufacturing, characterization, and stress, stability, and comparative studies or a combination thereof.
Expertise in advanced analytical instrumentation and nanoparticle characterization, including Cryo-EM, SAXS, DLS, NTA, DSC, fluorescence, and or optical techniques.
Strong combination of hands-on experimental expertise, analytical data generation and curation experience, quantitative data analysis, multivariate statistics, and an interest in developing interpretable machine-learning approaches.
Ability to integrate complex formulation, process, stability, biophysical, bioanalytical, and functional datasets from internal and external sources; apply sound scientific judgment; and communicate insights clearly.
Record of scientific productivity, including publications, presentations, or demonstrated research accomplishments.
Excellent problem-solving skills, including critical thinking, data interpretation, and scientific judgment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex scientific concepts clearly.
Demonstrated ability to work independently while seeking input and feedback from peers and supervisors.
Ability to collaborate effectively in a multidisciplinary, diverse, and fast-paced environment.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and timelines.

8+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or applied science (or 6+ years with a PhD), with a track record of delivering production-quality models that drove measurable business impact.

Experience building personalization, recommendation, decision-optimization, or marketing-science solutions, in any industry.

Effectively setup and troubleshoot automated equipment in primary and secondary packaging area within 3 value streams within standardized changeover target times. Responsible for proper handling and disposition of commodities used during setup and troubleshooting to minimize MUV.

Demonstrated focus and understanding of the importance of maintaining the highest level of quality and ensuring compliance to site level policies and procedures.
Ability to communicate issues to appropriate operations, engineering and mechanical team required.
Advanced understanding of pneumatics, electronics, mechanical, motors, variable frequency drives, encoders, servo motors, and different sensors required. Advanced understanding of HMI controls, vision inspection systems, and product serialization systems in order to troubleshoot and resolve inefficiencies in a timely manner.

Understanding and experience with systems such as POMs, SAP, and MAXIMO preferred.
4-5+ years of knowledge of related cGMP requirements and procedures preferred.

title: Sr. Manager, Regional Materials Management
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Purpose:
The Sr. Manager, Regional Materials Management is responsible for leading regional materials management activities for raw materials, commodities, and shared critical supplies across the biologics manufacturing region. The role drives inventory optimization, material availability, risk mitigation, and cross-site coordination to ensure uninterrupted supply while improving operational efficiency, inventory performance, and network responsiveness.
Major Responsibilities:
Lead regional planning and inventory management activities for raw materials, commodities, and shared critical supplies across multiple manufacturing sites.
Monitor regional inventory positions and direct inventory balancing, transfers, and redeployment strategies across sites to optimize supply continuity and mitigate surplus inventory to minimize obsolescence.
Serve as the primary escalation point for regional material shortages, supply disruptions, and inventory-related risks.
Partner with Procurement to develop material supply strategies and support sourcing decisions for shared and critical materials.
Lead regional initiatives to standardize material management processes, inventory policies, and planning practices across the network.
Support governance forums, planning reviews, and business processes including S&OP, Financial Plan, and Long-Range Planning activities.
Collaborate with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, Tech Ops, Procurement, and Finance leadership to resolve constraints and align priorities.
Monitor and report key performance indicators related to inventory health, material availability, stock-outs, excess and obsolete inventory, and planning effectiveness.
Partner with PDS&T, Procurement, AoS, CMM and Single Use COEs to develop and implement plans for deploying new materials and phasing out obsolete technologies
Lead continuous improvement projects focused on materials planning, inventory management, warehousing, logistics, and process efficiency.
Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
10+ years of Supply Chain, Materials Management, Manufacturing Operations, or Planning experience, including experience operating across multiple sites or a network environment.
Direct experience with SAP, preferably S/4HANA, supporting materials management and supply planning processes.
Demonstrated leadership of cross-functional initiatives involving inventory optimization, supply continuity, and operational improvement

The Technical Delivery Lead for Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) leads a small, high-velocity engineering team that embeds directly with frontline business partners across product development, manufacturing, Quality and Finance. Working side by side with scientists, operators, quality professionals and finance teams at our sites, this leader identifies critical business problems, then uses data science, AI and modern software engineering to design and ship working prototypes in weeks, not quarters.
This is more than an individual contributor engineering role. The successful candidate is accountable for the technical direction, quality and delivery pace of FDE engagements, leads and develops the engineers on each engagement, and is a hands-on builder who sets the technical bar for the team.
Responsibilities:
Technical delivery leadership
Serve as technical delivery lead for a portfolio of fast-paced FDE engagements, owning scope, architecture, technical risk, timelines, and outcomes from problem framing through prototype and handoff.
Lead, coach, and assign work to a team of forward deployed engineers, data scientists, and partner resources; set engineering standards, review designs and code, and build team capability.
Run short, iterative delivery cycles (e.g., discovery sprints, weekly demos) that move rapidly from hypothesis to a working solution in users’ hands.
Make clear build/buy/scale decisions and define the path from prototype to production with BTS platform, product, and support teams.
Frontline partnership
Travel to AbbVie sites to work directly with frontline employees—on the manufacturing floor, in labs, in Quality and in Finance—to observe workflows, understand pain points and co-design solutions.
Translate ambiguous operational and financial problems into well-defined technical problems with measurable success criteria (e.g., cycle time, yield, right-first-time, deviation reduction, close timeliness).
Build trusted relationships with site leaders and business stakeholders; communicate progress, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Hands-on solution development
Rapidly develop prototypes using data science, machine learning, generative AI / LLM and agentic tools, analytics, and application development frameworks.
Integrate with enterprise and operational data sources such as MES, LIMS, QMS, ERP (e.g., SAP), historians, and data lake / cloud platforms.
Apply AI-assisted development practices to accelerate delivery while maintaining code quality, security, and maintainability.
Ensure solutions are designed with appropriate data integrity, privacy, cybersecurity, and responsible AI considerations, and engage Quality/CSV partners early where GxP impact exists.
Scale and impact
Capture reusable patterns, components and playbooks so successful solutions can be replicated across sites and functions.
Quantify and report business value delivered by FDE engagements; help shape the FDE engagement model and pipeline with BTS Operations & Finance leadership.
Required:
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, a physical/life science, or related field with 7 years of relevant experience; Master’s Degree with 6 years of experience; or PhD with 2 years of experience.
Demonstrated experience delivering data, analytics, AI, or software solutions in the life sciences industry (pharmaceutical, biotech or medical device) across one or more of: product development, manufacturing, Quality or Finance.
Proven track record leading technical teams—setting direction, mentoring engineers and accountable for delivery of multiple concurrent projects.
Strong hands-on engineering skills in Python and SQL, with experience building and deploying ML/AI solutions, including generative AI / LLM applications.
Experience with cloud data and compute platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Databricks, Snowflake) and modern software practices (Git, CI/CD, APIs, containerization).
Experience working in rapid, iterative delivery environments—taking ambiguous problems to working prototypes on short timelines.
Working knowledge of regulated environments (GxP, data integrity, computerized system validation) and how they shape solution design.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable working directly with frontline staff and presenting to senior leaders.
Willingness and ability to travel to sites up to 20% of the time.
Preferred:
Prior forward deployed, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or internal innovation “skunkworks” team experience.
Familiarity with manufacturing and quality systems and data (MES, LIMS, QMS, historians such as OSIsoft PI) and/or finance systems (SAP, planning and close tools).
Experience with agentic AI frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, computer vision, or optimization/simulation methods.
Experience with full-stack or low-code application development for rapid user-facing tools (e.g., React, Streamlit, Power Apps).
Experience moving prototypes to scaled, supported production solutions in partnership with platform and product teams.

description:
Technology is changing faster than the public policies that govern it. As Senior Global Public Policy Manager, you will help us anticipate what's next, make sense of complex issues, and shape the conversations that influence innovation around the world.
The Opportunity
Adobe is looking for a public policy leader to join our Global Government Relations and Public Policy team. We work across Adobe to understand new public policy challenges, decide where we should engage, and help leaders respond as technology, government, and society evolve. In this role, you will develop positions and strategies on issues including artificial intelligence, digital trust, creator rights, competition, privacy, consumer protection, and the future of work.
We are looking for someone who enjoys solving difficult problems, connecting ideas, and turning uncertainty into action. You will work with colleagues across Adobe and with policymakers, industry groups, researchers, and other experts around the world. If you like building strategy, influencing decisions, and helping leaders prepare for what's ahead, we'd love to hear from you!
What You'll Do
Help us build Adobe's approach to technology and public policy issues around the world.
Spot emerging trends and explain what they could mean for Adobe, our customers, and our industry.
Turn complicated issues into clear recommendations, policy positions, and action plans.
Lead work from early research through strategy, internal alignment, and external engagement.
Advise senior leaders on risks, opportunities, and possible paths forward.
Work with Product, Legal, Engineering, Communications, Trust & Safety, and Government Relations to build shared plans and move work forward.
Develop policy positions, executive briefings, presentations, submissions, and advocacy materials.
Build relationships with policymakers, industry groups, researchers, and outside experts.
Represent Adobe in policy discussions and help shape outcomes in markets around the world.
Help our teams prepare for what's next.
What You'll Need to Succeed
8+ years of experience in public policy, government, business strategy, consulting, public affairs, political campaigns, or a related field.
An interest in technology and how it affects people, businesses, and governments.
Strong writing and speaking skills, with the ability to explain complicated ideas clearly.
Sound judgment and the ability to make sense of incomplete or conflicting information.
Experience advising senior leaders and helping them make decisions.
A record of building support across teams with different priorities.
The ability to develop a strategy, put it into action, and adjust as circumstances change.
Comfort working through ambiguity and moving work forward without a playbook.
The ability to balance long-term goals with near-term results.
A willingness to learn new subjects quickly and take ownership from problem definition through delivery.
Experience working across countries or adapting an approach to different political, regulatory, or market settings.
What Sets You Apart
You ask good questions and quickly identify what matters.
You connect policy developments to business goals and turn insight into action.
You build trust, listen to different views, and help groups reach decisions.
You are as comfortable drafting a memo as you are leading a meeting or briefing an executive.
You take ownership, follow through, and focus on results.
You are excited to help us shape what's next!

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
The Community You Will Join:
In Community Policy, our mission is to create and evolve principled policies that establish the rules of the road for guests and hosts across Airbnb. This involves solving some of the most complex Trust & Safety challenges of our time. Our work is informed by rigorous research and stakeholder collaboration, and we design policies that can support our community at scale. We team with our cross-functional partners to create accessible policy enforcement guides and to continuously maintain and improve our policies.
The Difference You Will Make:
As a Senior Manager for Community Policy, you will partner closely with stakeholders across the company to support Airbnb's strategic objectives. You will lead policy development in the anti-discrimination and safety space, addressing real-world harms and ensuring every host and guest is treated fairly. This role entails understanding the needs of hosts and guests and collaborating closely with our operations, legal, business, design, and product teams. The policies you build will directly shape how millions of hosts and guests experience Airbnb and their confidence in the platform.
About You
You are a seasoned policy leader who loves solving complex problems and collaborating cross-functionally.
You have deep expertise in the anti-discrimination space and a track record in safety policies addressing real-world harms.
You are an excellent communicator with exceptional writing skills.
You are an adept presenter with experience engaging with all levels of leadership, including senior executives.
You are a team player who thrives in a fast-moving environment and brings a strategic mindset and bias toward execution.
You are principled, have meticulous attention to detail, and incorporate diverse perspectives in pursuit of the best decisions and outcomes possible.
You are experienced at developing and implementing policies and measuring their effectiveness.
You are proactively data-driven: you don't wait for problems to surface — you seek out data, research, and insights to identify gaps and opportunities to improve policies before they become issues.
A Typical Day:
Have broad ownership over our policies affecting trust in Airbnb, especially in the anti-discrimination and safety space
Lead policy development and draft clear and scalable policy frameworks that keep pace with company priorities
Foster, build, and maintain relationships with cross-functional stakeholders across the business including Operations, Legal, Anti-Discrimination and Equity, Public Policy, Product, Communications, and Supply, acting as a trusted policy partner who helps teams move forward
Guide policy operationalization efforts in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders
Proactively use data, research, and community insights to evaluate existing policies, identify improvement opportunities, and drive revisions before issues escalate
Serve as subject matter expert to provide sound policy guidance for time-sensitive escalations, including from Operations and company leadership
Your Expertise:
10-15+ years of experience in a Policy, Legal, or Trust and Safety role
Prior policy leadership addressing discrimination and safety issues in a complex international setting
Thoughtful business judgment, strategic thinking, and ability to work well under pressure
Exceptional writing and communication skills
Demonstrated capacity for critical thinking, research, and analysis
Strong attention to detail
A track record of strong leadership and an ability to independently manage a portfolio of challenging issues
Fluency in data analysis and leading data-driven decision-making
Deep understanding of the end-to-end policy process and how to influence policy delivery
Experience working in a matrix and driving solutions to complex problems through cross-functional collaboration
Ability to explain and simplify complex information to others

title: Principal Product Manager, Technical, Ads , APM
description:
Omni-channel advertising is reshaping how advertisers achieve their marketing objectives on Amazon and beyond. In this role, you will serve as the single-threaded leader of a product, engineering, science, and business development team charged with bringing Amazon's omni-channel advertising vision to life. You and your team will work across partner teams — including the Amazon Demand-Side Platform (DSP), Supply-Side Platform (SSP), and go-to-market organizations — to define the product strategy, build the technology, and drive advertiser adoption. You will design advertiser-facing workflows powered by generative AI, partner with teams building creative transformation technology that converts a single advertiser asset into display, audio, and video formats, and identify and resolve gaps in ad-serving and bidding logic that limit omni-channel performance. If you are a technically curious product leader who thrives on turning ambiguous, high-impact opportunities into concrete results, we would love to hear from you.
Key job responsibilities
- Own the 3–5 year product vision and strategic roadmap for omni-channel advertising, translating broad market opportunity into a sequenced plan of deliverables with clear trade-offs and measurable outcomes.
- Lead end-to-end product development across engineering, science, design, and business development teams, deconstructing complex technical challenges into straightforward solutions and driving alignment across multiple organizations.
- Define and coordinate experimentation strategies — including multi-phase testing programs — to validate hypotheses around ad-serving optimization, creative transformation, and advertiser adoption, using data and metrics to inform investment decisions.
- Partner as a technical peer with engineering and applied science teams to evaluate architecture proposals for extensibility, scalability, and performance, ensuring today's decisions do not constrain tomorrow's strategic options.
- Drive strategic communications through written narratives, business reviews, and executive forums, influencing senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to secure resources and align priorities.
A day in the life
Your morning might begin with a deep-dive into experiment results from a new ad-format test, deciding whether the signal warrants scaling or pivoting. By mid-morning you are in an architecture review with engineering, weighing trade-offs in real-time bidding logic. After lunch you lead a cross-team alignment session to resolve a prioritization conflict between your roadmap and a partner team's deliverables. Later you draft a vision document for a whitespace opportunity you have been researching, pulling together advertiser feedback, usage data, and competitive signals. You close the day by reviewing a generative AI prototype your team built to streamline creative workflows, pressure-testing the output quality before greenlighting the next sprint.
About the team
Our team sits within Amazon Ads and is focused on making omni-channel advertising simple and effective for advertisers of every size. We build the products and technology that let advertisers reach customers across display, audio, and video through a unified experience. The team is a collaborative mix of product managers, software engineers, applied scientists, and business development professionals who work closely with partner teams across the DSP, SSP, and sales organizations. We are investing in generative AI, creative automation, and advanced bidding systems — and this role will be at the center of shaping what comes next.

- 7+ years of end to end product delivery experience
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with and deep understanding of advertising technologies (i.e., ad server, DSP)
Preferred qualifications: - Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, GDCO Central Intelligence and Analytics Team
description:
We're looking for a Senior Technical Product/Program Manager to own a portfolio of these business-facing products and programs end to end: shaping what each one should do and for whom, driving its design and delivery with engineering, science and data technicians, and proving it changes business outcomes. This role is oriented toward business problems and the products/programs that solve them, not toward running shared platform infrastructure. You'll be as comfortable reviewing a system architecture or challenging a recommendations quality as presenting a roadmap to senior executives like VPs.
## The portfolio you'll own
- **Self-service analytics, to production.** Take our natural-language and SQL analytics product over the governed data lake from team tool to a production service leaders rely on: accuracy on governed metrics, onboarding new domains, reliability, access controls, and adoption.
- **Recommendation engine delivery and quality.** Deliver the AI-assisted recommendation engine from pilot to broad use, own its quality bar: what it recommends, with what confidence, when it should stay silent, and how we know it worked.
- **Business domain decision products.** Our operation runs on a few core business domains, each with its own leaders, metrics, data sources, and decisions. For each one, you'll own the product that moves a leader from "what's happening" to "what should I do about it": define the decisions it supports, the metrics and data it needs, and how we measure whether it improved the domain's outcome. Today that means: data products that cover repair backlog and aging, repair throughput and turnaround time, parts availability and other blockers, and repeat failures. The core decision is where to focus the effort so it returns the most capacity to customers fastest. Data products track deliveries from plan through install and hand-off, show what's on track, what's at risk, and why (parts, labor, facilities, network readiness), and route each blocker to the owner who can clear it. The core decision is which at-risk deliveries need intervention now. Success is more capacity delivered on its committed date.
Key job responsibilities
- **Own program strategy and roadmap** for each product/program in the portfolio, tied to a business outcome (repair turnaround, labor productivity, capacity on time), and phase scope deliberately from pilot to GA.

Partner with engineering and science so no product presents correlation as causation or claims more confidence than it has earned.
- **Prove business impact.** Define how actions are captured, how impact is measured against matched baselines, and how outcomes feed back into the product. Success is not "recommendations accepted" or "queries run"; it's decisions that changed outcomes.
- **Run technical delivery with the engineering team.** Own the delivery cadence, sprint planning, and release management for your products/programs. Review design docs, understand the architecture well enough to weigh tradeoffs (build vs. reuse, latency vs. cost, coupling between services), and keep scope, sequencing, and dependencies honest.

- **Lead cross-org dependencies** with Supply Chain, Hardware Engineering, Facilities, workforce planning, and peer data teams: write the asks, negotiate data contracts, and escalate when a partner dependency blocks the roadmap.

title: AIML - Site Lead & Lead Researcher, Foundation Models

title: Design Verification Engineer
description:
At Apple, we work every single day to craft products that enrich people’s lives. Do you love working on challenges that no one has solved yet and changing the game? We have an opportunity for an outstandingly hardworking design verification engineer! As a member of our wide-ranging group, you will have the rare and extraordinary opportunity to craft upcoming products that will delight and encourage millions of Apple’s customers daily.
This role is for a DV engineer who will enable us to produce fully functional first silicon for IP designs. The responsibilities include all phases of pre-silicon verification including but not limited to: establishing DV methodology, test-plan development, verification environment development including stimulus and checkers, test-writing, debug, coverage, sign-off for RTL freeze and tape-out.
In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring bug-free first silicon for part of the SoC / IP and are encouraged to develop detailed test and coverage plans based on the micro-architecture. You are responsible for developing verification methodology suitable for the IP, ensuring a scalable and portable environment. You will get to develop verification environment, including all the respective components such as stimulus, checkers, assertions, trackers, coverage. A mindset to break the design is highly desirable.
Furthermore, you will develop verification plans for all features under your care, execute verification plans, including design bring-up, DV environment bring- up, regression enabling features, and debug of the test failures. You will also learn to develop block, IP and SoC level test-benches track and report DV progress using a variety of metrics, including bugs and coverage. You will also be expected to make use of LLM and related technologies to achieve efficient execution and improved quality.
Minimum qualifications: BS degree in technical subject area and a minimum 3 years relevant industry experience or equivalent.
Preferred qualifications: MS degree in a technical subject area and relevant industry experience strongly preferred
Strong knowledge of OOP, SystemVerilog and UVM
Strong knowledge in developing scalable and portable testbenches
Proven experience with verification methodologies and tools such as simulators, waveform viewer, build and run automation, coverage collection, and gate-level simulations
Working experience using LLMs for efficiency and quality
Experience with power-aware (UPF) or similar verification methodology
Knowledge of one of the scripting languages such as Python, Perl, TCL
Some experience with serial protocols such as PCIe or USB, parallel protocol such as DDR is a plus but not required
Knowledge of formal verification methodology is a plus but not required

title: Digital Mixed Signal Design and Modeling Engineer
description:
Join our team at Apple developing complex mixed-signal IPs for Apple’s custom integrated circuits. Our team has shipped hundreds of millions of chips into Apple’s existing product lines, and is developing new chips for future product lines!

In addition to traditional digital circuit simulation, you will have the opportunity to learn and use other verification techniques such as formal verification, digital mixed signal verification, and analog mixed signal simulation using state-of-the-art tools.
Although the team is small, we supply silicon to most of Apple’s industry leading hardware development teams. BS and a minimum of 10 years relevant industry experience.

Taking designs from concept through manufacturing & test, perform mechanical assembly for quick prototypes, and bring-up/debug & validation of digital designs.

title: SoC Power Spec Engineer
description:
Do you have a passion for crafting new solutions? As part of our Silicon Engineering group, you will generate ideas and turn them into reality. You will be part of the team responsible for crafting state-of-the-art ASICs that are integral to many Apple products. We are looking for an engineer who will work on the modeling of power dissipation of various IPs and applications, including AI/ML and power modeling at the SOC/system level for Apple products. This role provides an opportunity to participate in optimization of a variety of leading edge chips for power-efficiency. You will collaborate across many teams including architecture, SOC design, and system design. The job also involves partnering with the lab and silicon characterization/validation teams on correlating the models to the silicon data.
The job involves collaborating across many fields and playing a role of getting innovative products to millions of customers. You will have the opportunity to build new insights into silicon optimization, as well as work with architects, silicon design engineers, software developers, and be involved in silicon/model correlation efforts of mobile SoC design.
Your main responsibilities will be:
-Modeling power dissipation at the SOC level, including Neural Engines, CPUs, Graphics, compute ( AI/ML) accelerators, media IPs, caches and fabric.
-Modeling power dissipation for customer use-cases.
-Interacting with the System designers, Technology team, Silicon Validation, and Product Engineering teams to define power targets at the SOC level, and the power delivery.
-Working with the power lab and test teams to correlate models to silicon data.
Minimum qualifications: A minimum of a bachelor's degree in relevant field and a minimum of 10 years of relevant industry experience.
Preferred qualifications: We would prefer our SoC Power Spec Engineer to have the following qualifications:
MSEE preferred
Deep knowledge of SOC architecture and power modeling.
Deep understanding of SOC building blocks including CPU, GPU, caches, memory and media IPs
Skills in scripting and data analysis.
Understanding of VLSI design flow and CMOS technology and background in EE.
Ability to understand and model thermal control loops and throttling mechanisms.
Strong teammate with excellent communication skills.

title: SoC Power Validation Engineer
description:
As part of our Silicon Engineering group, you will take imaginative and revolutionary ideas and determine how to turn them into reality! You and your team will apply engineering fundamentals and start from scratch if needed, bringing forward-thinking ideas to the real world. Join us, and you will help design products that bring to our customers experiences they’ve never before envisioned!
You will be part of an exciting silicon design group that is responsible for designing state-of-the-art ASICs. We have an extraordinary opportunity for Validation Engineers.
The SoC hardware development team is looking for a motivated engineer to fill a full-time position. The primary role is to engage in power hardware validation and analysis of typical SoC workloads. The analysis of the workloads and their power dissipation will help drive the power optimization efforts to achieve best-in-class power/performance.
Imagine yourself at the center of our SOC design effort, collaborating with all fields, playing a strategic role of getting functional products to millions of customers quickly. You will have the opportunity to integrate and come-up with new ideas, as well as work with a team of industrious engineers. As a member of the SoC power team, you will get involved in the power validation efforts of mobile SoCs.
The main responsibilities of this role are:
- Measure in silicon power dissipation of typical workloads (e.g., video streaming, video recording, etc.), analyze data, and correlate measurements with simulation results.
- Have a close collaboration with design, architecture, systems, and software teams, hence strong communication and teamwork skills are essential.
- Perform silicon power measurements and correlate with simulations/projections.
- Work with multi-functional teams to enable use-case power measurements.
- Improve use-case energy efficiency through tuning of hardware and software settings.
- Improve power measurement infrastructure.
Minimum qualifications: A minimum of a bachelor's degree in relevant field and a minimum of 3 years of relevant industry experience.
Preferred qualifications: We are looking for applicants with experience in phenomenal programming skills and understanding of low-power digital design and power fundamentals, including:
- Expertise on C/Assembly programming and associated tool chains.
- Use of basic lab equipment such as multi-meter units, oscilloscopes, etc.
- Calculations for dynamic and static power in CMOS.
- Strong communication skills and ability to work as a team.

description:

You will work in a fast paced environment, interacting directly with development teams within the organization as well as cross-functional teams. The nature of the position requires excellent communication skills, strong multi-tasking abilities & deep technical and debugging skills, along with a drive to make a difference. The ideal candidate will be highly technical, creative, motivated, and results driven.

Solid OS & Embedded Systems fundamentals
Familiarity with Python/C++/C programming
Preferred qualifications: Experience with developing, testing or debugging device drivers, firmware or other low level software
Experience in working with I/O technologies (USB, PCIe, Display technologies etc.)
Experience using Protocol Analyzers & Oscilloscope.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test, Customer Systems
description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization.
IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.
Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.
Customer Systems is part of IS&T and drives the technology behind Apple's customer support experience — from contact center operations to the software powering the iconic Genius Bar. The team also builds and operates AppleCare's online support platform, which handles 6 billion visits per year, delivering seamless, high-quality support to Apple customers around the globe.
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.
Apple’s Customer Experience Engineering team is looking for a passionate Software Quality Engineer to contribute to design, analysis and certification of our support apps. We are looking for someone who is equally passionate about quality and using light weight processes to consistently achieve it. The role would also involve interacting with cross-functional engineering and product teams to test features, perform root cause analysis, and drive the quality of our customer's experience.
In this dynamic and fast-paced role, you will be directly responsible for ensuring the quality of Apple's customer support experience, focusing on consistent functionality, performance, and stability. This involves understanding new and existing feature implementations to craft informed and robust testing charters, authoring test scenarios, scripts, and plans, and then executing functional, performance, and stability testing. You will also write and review automation test scripts, identify and report defects with first-level root cause analysis and consistent reproduction steps, and champion quality efforts by collaborating with test automation engineering, product management, and engineering program teams.
Minimum qualifications: 4+ years experience in software quality assurance testing. Experience as a team lead preferred.
Hands-on experience building and maintaining test frameworks using tools such as RestAssured or Selenium
Proficiency in one or multiple languages such as Java, Python etc.
Preferred qualifications: Experience testing iOS native and Safari-based web applications.
Experience with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling) and load/stress/scalability testing practices.
Knowledge of AI-driven testing tools

title: Software Engineer - Traffic, Envoy
description:
Apple services depend upon performant and reliable networking primitives. Our mission is to connect all services in secure, scalable and transparent matter. This includes implementing networking and traffic primitives for resilient service to service communication. These capabilities are packaged into ingress, egress, and mesh proxies at Apple scale.
As a Traffic Engineer you will orchestrate the design and development of cutting-edge traffic proxies that power Apple services at an unprecedented scale, serving hundreds of millions of users globally. As a key player in our tech ecosystem, you will take the lead in enhancing our network stack for improved ingress, egress, and mesh functionality.
This role is not just about coding; it's about making contributions architecting the backbone of Apple, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the realm of software development. If you're passionate about tackling challenges at an extraordinary scale, innovating in the traffic management space, and influencing the direction of an industry giant, this is your opportunity to shine!
Senior engineers will be expected to excel at making informed technology choices within complex architectures, whether it's deciding to build or buy specific components and selecting the right frameworks. Your deep understanding of the organization's business, products, customers, and strategy will empower us to pinpoint opportunities aligning with our team's mission.
We expect senior engineers to make decisive choices even amid conflicting perspectives, demonstrating our commitment by disagreeing when necessary and then committing to the chosen path. Our dedication extends to coaching and mentoring teammates, considering their unique skills, backgrounds, and working styles. You will actively seek and provide constructive feedback to foster growth within our team.
Here you will find that we:
• Have a peaceful work environment where you can choose when to socialize and when to focus.
• Provide technical guidance and mentorship as needed.
• Have an encouraging and growth-focused workplace culture.
• Encourage you to use accrued vacation time and maintain a healthy work-life balance.
• Offer excellent benefits!

5+ years of relevant industry experience
Professional expertise in software engineering
Skilled with one or more advanced programming language such as C, C++, Java or Go
Full product lifecycle ownership mindset (design → implementation → production)
Experience with core production engineering best practices (e.g., designing for operability and scalability, adopting SLOs, eliminating toil).

title: Software Engineer, Information Systems & Technology
description:
Join us, the team that serves as Apple’s nerve center: Apple Information Systems and Technology group! We are looking for Java Software Engineers, who will work closely with other Software Engineers, Project & Product Managers, Product Designers, and other internal & external partners.
