title: Sr Security Incident Response Engineer, AIS
description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly.
Apple Information Security is looking for an experienced Incident Response engineer to help protect Apple, our customers, and our data. This is work where the stakes are real, the scope is global and the decisions you make during an incident shape outcomes across the company.
We're a diverse collection of thinkers and doers who are continually reimagining how threats get identified, contained, and mitigated. You'll bring deep technical judgment, the instinct to anticipate an attacker's next move rather than only recognize the last one, and work with other responders to build a stronger team. This is a deeply collaborative role where operations, critical thinking, and technology converge, and where you'll be trusted to own hard calls and build the capabilities the team relies for handling complex security incidents.
Bring your passion and dedication to this job, and there's no telling what you could accomplish.
Apple Information Security is seeking a senior security professional to join its Incident Response team. The successful candidate brings a proven technical background and substantial Information Security experience, with deep focus across the incident response lifecycle.
You'll work with a global team of security professionals on a follow-the-sun model, focused primarily on the identification, containment, and mitigation of security incidents. You'll be trusted to drive complex, ambiguous investigations to resolution with minimal guidance, to set the bar for investigative quality, and to up-level the team around you. You'll also help move the function forward, turning what you learn in one investigation into durable capability the whole team benefits from. This person will have the opportunity to work on technology and processes with global reach.
Minimum qualifications: B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar degree and/or equivalent 5+ years of experience in Information Security with a focus on Incident Response, Security Engineering, and/or Intrusion Detection, including significant hands-on response work
Demonstrated ability to drive investigations independently — comfortable testing hypotheses, establishing root cause, and applying policy and remediation strategies
Demonstrated experience mentoring and coaching other responders, sharing expertise in a way that measurably improves the work of those around you
Strong understanding of incident response automation strategies, with a track record of implementing them
Proficiency in one or more programming or scripting languages
Preferred qualifications: Proven ownership of complex, ambiguous problems through to resolution, with sound judgment about what to decide and when to escalate
Strong understanding of threat modeling, operational threat intelligence, and common attack vectors
Strong understanding on AI to apply innovation into IR processes through controlled, replicable and traceable strategies.
Deep working knowledge of modern identity management, with the ability to reason about and determine blast radius within an incident
Practical understanding of attacker tradecraft sufficient to anticipate the next step rather than only recognize the last one
Has repeatedly turned a one-off investigation into durable capability — a detection, a query, a reusable process
Curiosity about emerging attack surfaces and vectors
Fluency analyzing large-scale datasets, context-switching between data sources, and working directly with raw telemetry during investigations
Working competence across several of: endpoint/OS internals, cloud control planes, SaaS platforms, corporate IT infrastructure, and developer/CI-CD environments
Experience in malware analysis, digital forensics, intrusion detection, and/or threat intelligence
Technical certifications are a plus (OSCP, GIAC, CCNP/CCIE, and similar)
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to brief audiences with varying levels of technical context

title: Sr Security Operations (SecOps) Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Operations (SecOps) Engineer to help define and drive the security strategy for applications, cloud infrastructure, and engineering platforms. We are particularly interested in a hands-on engineer who can build and integrate reusable security platforms, automation, and intelligent controls that make security proactive and scalable as software and AI-enabled systems evolve. You will serve as a senior technical security partner to application engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, platform engineering, and Apple Information Security teams.
Sales and Operations Engineering is part of IS&T and drives the technology behind Apple's global operations, sales, and supply chain. The team connects the systems that move products from factory to customer — bridging sales platforms with the operational infrastructure that keeps Apple running at scale and ensuring Apple's technology and business priorities move in lockstep.
In this role, you will lead complex security assessments and threat modeling, define scalable security controls, influence application and infrastructure architecture, and develop automation that enables security to be embedded throughout the software development lifecycle. You will identify systemic security risks and create engineering solutions that improve security across multiple applications and teams rather than relying on manual or application-specific controls. You will connect security signals to application ownership, business context, and engineering workflows so that teams can prioritize and remediate the risks that matter most.
You will combine deep security expertise with software, cloud, and infrastructure engineering experience to help teams design and operate secure systems at scale. You will also evaluate how AI-assisted and agentic workflows can responsibly improve security analysis, detection, triage, and remediation, while helping teams manage the new risks introduced by AI-enabled applications and agents.
Minimum qualifications: 8+ years of experience in security engineering, application security, cloud security, DevSecOps, infrastructure security, security operations, or a related engineering discipline.
8+ years of experience leading security reviews, threat modeling, risk assessments, and remediation of complex distributed or cloud-native systems.
8+ years of experience in application security, cloud security, identity and access management, network security, vulnerability management, and secure software development.
5+ years of experience in securing production environments in AWS, GCP, or another major cloud platform.
5+ years of experience in programming or automation experience (for example Python, Go, or Java), including building integrations, services, or repeatable engineering workflows.
5+ years of experience in integrating security capabilities into at least one of CI/CD, developer workflows, infrastructure-as-code, or production engineering systems.
Bachelors Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
Preferred qualifications: Experience securing cloud-native applications and workloads including Kubernetes, containers, APIs, and modern distributed architectures.
Strong experience integrating security controls into CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code workflows.
Practical experience integrating or operating several security testing and posture capabilities (e.g., SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, container security, or CSPM), with judgment about which controls are useful in different workflows.
Demonstrated experience designing or developing security automation using Python, Go, Java, Bash, or another programming language. Experience building APIs or integrations across security and engineering systems is particularly valuable.
Experience leading vulnerability assessment, prioritization, remediation, and risk-management activities across multiple engineering teams.
Ability to translate complex technical security risks into actionable recommendations for engineers, managers, and senior leadership.
Demonstrated ability to influence architecture and security outcomes across multiple engineering organizations.
Experience building or integrating reusable security controls, automation, or self-service capabilities adopted by more than one team.
Ability to take an ambiguous security problem from design through a working, maintainable technical solution.
Experience participating in or leading security incident response, investigation, root cause analysis, and preventative remediation.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Security, or equivalent practical experience.
Advanced Kubernetes or multi-tenant cloud security experience.
Experience identifying security enforcement opportunities within Terraform, CloudFormation, CI/CD systems, Kubernetes admission controls, or similar platforms.
Strong knowledge of threat modeling methodologies, offensive security techniques, application penetration testing, and secure architecture principles.
Experience with security tooling and platforms for vulnerability management, SAST/DAST, secrets management, runtime security, SIEM, and cloud security.
Experience with Splunk, OpenSearch, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar observability and security analytics technologies.
Understanding of software supply-chain security, SBOM, artifact signing, provenance, dependency security, and secure build pipelines.
Experience designing security metrics, risk scoring models, dashboards, and executive-level security reporting.
Experience securing AI/ML workloads, LLM applications, model pipelines, or agent-based systems.
Experience building or directing the use of AI/ML or agentic security tooling to scale security assessment, vulnerability analysis, incident investigation, or remediation.

title: Sr. AI Inference Platform Engineer
description:
We are looking for senior engineer to build tooling, automation, and analysis capabilities that strengthen our AI inference platform. This role will focus on developing sophisticated performance benchmarking systems, capacity projection models, and data analysis pipelines that directly inform our AI infrastructure teams and capacity planners. You'll work at the intersection of AI systems performance, distributed infrastructure, and software engineering to help the team make data-driven decisions about scaling and optimizing our inference platform.
At Apple, we believe the future of AI is defined not just by models, but by the infrastructure that powers them. Our AI inference platform sits at the heart of products and experiences used by hundreds of millions of people worldwide, and we are building the systems that ensure it scales reliably, efficiently, and intelligently.
As part of our next-generation datacenter engineering team, you will play a critical role in shaping how we understand, measure, and grow our AI infrastructure. You will design and build the tooling and analysis systems that give our engineers and capacity planners a clear, real-time picture of performance across our fleet. Your work will directly influence how we invest in hardware, how we detect regressions before they reach production, and how we forecast capacity needs months in advance.
This is a high-impact, cross-functional role for an engineer who is energized by complexity, thrives on turning raw data into actionable insight, and wants to work on problems that matter at massive scale.
Minimum qualifications: BS or MS in Computer Science or related technical field.
Solid understanding of AI/ML inference architecture and the performance characteristics of serving systems.
7 or more years of experience with performance and infrastructure engineering in distributed systems.
7 years of experience coding in Python, Go, C++, or other programming languages.
Experience with automation engineering, tooling, and data pipelines to support engineering workflows.
Strong knowledge of GPU/accelerator architecture as it relates to AI workloads.
Practical statistical knowledge applicable to performance analysis and forecasting.
Excellent communication skills and ability to turn data into clear guidance for infrastructure teams and capacity planners.
Preferred qualifications: Experience with performance benchmarking and methodologies for AI/ML inference systems.
Familiarity with capacity planning and forecasting/projection models for large-scale infrastructure.
Experience with GPU profiling and observability tools (e.g., Nsight, other vendor-specific profilers).
Experience with data visualization and reporting tools/frameworks for surfacing performance trends to stakeholders.

title: Wireless Module Engineer
description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something. The Wireless Module Engineer (WME) is well-versed in multiple fields for wireless module development: RF design, packaging, product engineering (including yield analysis), ATE, and reliability engineering.
The Wireless Module Engineer (WME) is a highly motivated, self-driven technical lead responsible for driving the development of wireless modules from early architecture definition through mass-production ramp. This role requires strong cross-functional collaboration and the ability to deeply engage across a broad spectrum of technical domains including RF design, reliability, manufacturing test, supply chain, and system integration. The WME will initiate and lead early-phase RF architecture and specification discussions between internal engineering teams and Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly & Test (OSAT). They will ensure all OSATs comply with internal specification formats, review procedures, and approval workflows. The WME will drive the formal module design release process, establishing and reviewing checkpoints for schematics, PCB layout, electromagnetic/RF simulation results, design-for-manufacturability (DFM), test data readiness, and OSAT design feedback
In addition to communicating risks and priorities, the core responsibility of WME is to manage module integration and ATE test coverage at OSATs. WME will function as a general manager overseeing all aspects of ATE maturity preparation for hardware—such as load boards, daughter cards, sockets, and handlers—and software, firmware, module calibrations, GRR, and CPK/data analysis.
This role is expected to drive OSATs, set priorities, and collaborate closely with them to validate and approve the final ATE hardware and software integration, test coverage, and corresponding test limits, ensuring timely delivery of tested modules for product NPI builds. Following the NPI builds, WME will lead the failure analysis process with the OSATs and work with them to implement improvement activities, including enhancing ATE testers, optimizing software/firmware test time, and improving overall yield and retest rates. This role will involve traveling to international OSATs for Module & ATE bring up for 1-2 weeks before the product NPI builds. WME is expected to have a broad spectrum of technical depth to debug additional bring up issues during travel. For e.g. I2C & PCIe interface related issues. This team member will facilitate collaboration with multi-functional groups at Apple and define the test coverage. Typical test coverage includes but not limited to Open-Short & Continuity test, VCO calibration and test, TX/RX power calibration and test, RF packet test, EVM test, RX sensitivity test. They will collaborate closely with internal reliability engineering teams to translate expected product field-usage profiles into feasible and data-driven reliability test models for modules and components. This role supports multiple product lines within the Hardware Technology organization, ensuring technical excellence, risk visibility, and disciplined execution from early concept through manufacturing ramp.
Minimum qualifications: BS and a minimum of 10 years relevant industry experience
Strong RF fundamentals.
Proven track record for effective written/verbal communication, leading projects with self-motivation.
Preferred qualifications: 2 or more years of wireless module development experience from early concept to MP for consumer electronic devices.
Strong RF design background. Additional experience in packaging, product engineering, ATE, and reliability engineering is highly desirable.
Strong data analysis skills including yield analysis (Cpk), and retest rate analysis, required for data sheet closures.
Capable of working at both high-level theory and detailed hands-on execution.
Experienced in managing vendor teams and leading cross-time-zone meetings.
AI/ML experience with expertise in Data Analysis is a plus.

Develop capabilities for multi-tenant routing and Apollo contracts to support external and internal product use cases.

1. Third Party Partner Performance Management

DoorDash's marketing product operations team is the connective tissue between our Retention Marketing organization and the tools, systems, and data that power it. As an Associate Manager on CRM Automation, you'll own developing the AI-powered automation that helps our Campaign Operators build, edit, QA, and monitor CRM campaigns faster and with fewer errors across every audience we serve.
You'll partner closely with Campaign Operators to find where manual work slows them down. You’ll use these learnings to then partner with our Martech team to design, ship, and scale internal AI-enabled tools and workflows that remove it. This is a highly cross-functional, builder-oriented role for someone who wants to own CRM automation end-to-end.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Own and evolve the CRM automation roadmap, using DoorDash's internal AI tools to help Campaign Operators build, edit, QA, and monitor campaigns more efficiently
Identify high-effort manual steps in campaign build and edit workflows and design AI-assisted automations to replace them
Apply AI to campaign QA and ongoing monitoring so issues are caught early and surfaced quickly across all audiences
Partner cross-functionally with Campaign Operators, Marketing, Martech, and Product to define requirements and prioritize what to automate next
Track and report on adoption, time saved, and campaign error rates to demonstrate the impact of automation
Build documentation, SOPs, and training that help Campaign Operators adopt new tools and workflows with confidence
We’re excited about you because…
4+ years of experience in marketing technology, marketing operations, CRM marketing, program management, or a similar operational role at a technology company
Hands-on experience building, editing, or operating CRM campaigns in marketing automation platforms (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, Responsys, or similar)
Fluency with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) and a demonstrated ability to apply them to automate repetitive work
Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional projects – defining milestones, managing dependencies, and keeping stakeholders aligned
Comfort working with data to track adoption and efficiency metrics and surface insights; experience with dashboards or basic SQL a plus
Strong written and verbal communication skills – able to translate technical automation into plain language for campaign operators
Detail-oriented with a high bar for quality; you notice what's missing before others do
Nice to Have
Experience building automations or workflows with AI tools, scripts, APIs, or low-code/no-code platforms
Experience working across multiple brands/audiences (e.g., consumer, B2B, international)
Basic SQL knowledge for querying campaign or usage data
Experience writing internal documentation, training materials, or adoption playbooks

description:
About the Team
We're looking for someone to help scale DoorDash's next billion dollar business, DashMart, by growing our in-house food program, DashMart Kitchens. The DashMart Kitchens team is focused on building a new type of restaurant platform within DashMart, offering a broad selection of prepared foods and well-known restaurant staples to our customers' doorsteps.

DoorDash Security exists to keep it that way, protecting our people, property, operations, brand, and reputation across all our markets. Our DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt brands now span more than 40 countries, dozens of offices, and tens of thousands of employees. That growth demands a global Cyber Defense function built to match it.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Proactive Security - Platform
description:
About the Team
At DoorDash we're building the industry's most scalable and reliable delivery network to support our three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and Dashers. Security Engineering is paramount to the success of our business, and DoorDash Security aspires to be one of the world's most admired Security Engineering teams. We are committed to building the world's most trusted on-demand logistics engine for delivery! We're expanding our team of great minds to help us secure and maintain a 24x7, no downtime, global infrastructure system that powers DoorDash's multi-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and Dashers.
About the Role
Our Proactive Security Engineering team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Proactive Security - Platform to build the paved paths that engineers across DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo use to access infrastructure, manage secrets and authenticate services.
You will be part of our inclusive, collaborative global Security Engineering Platform team responsible for building and operating tier-0 security services for access management, secret storage and identity, including our in-house Access Platform, Teleport and HashiCorp Vault. Your job is to make the secure path the easiest path: self-service, well documented, and built into the tooling engineers already use every day.
This is a US remote position reporting directly to the Manager of our Proactive Security Engineering Platform team.
You're excited about this opportunity because you will…
Design, build and operate paved paths for privileged access, secrets management and identity on top of our access management and secret storage platforms.
Build self-service tooling, SDKs, Terraform modules and integrations that let engineering teams adopt just-in-time access, short-lived credentials and dynamic secrets without filing a ticket.
Design and operate highly available distributed systems, including replication, consistency and consensus, that underpin tier-0 services.
Drive migrations off long-lived credentials and standing access. Success is measured in classes of exposure eliminated at the platform layer, not in shipping code for its own sake.
Partner with Core Infrastructure, Compute, Data and product engineering teams to integrate paved paths into Kubernetes, CI/CD, and AWS and GCP environments across DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo.
Participate in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation for tier-0 security services and raise the bar on Operational Excellence through monitoring, runbooks, incident response and root cause analysis.
Help enable the secure adoption of AI tooling and agentic workflows through access control and secrets brokering for agents.
We're excited about you because…
6+ years of experience as a Software, Infrastructure or Security Platform Engineer at an internet scale organization.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Security Engineering, a related field or equivalent work experience.
Strong software engineering skills in Go (or Kotlin, Java, Python), building production services and developer tooling.
Hands-on experience building or operating access management and secret storage systems, such as PAM, secrets management or key management platforms. Experience with Teleport or HashiCorp Vault is a plus.
Solid understanding of distributed systems, including replication, consistency and distributed consensus (e.g. Raft, Paxos).
Working knowledge of identity and authentication standards such as OIDC, SAML, mTLS and workload identity (e.g. SPIFFE, AWS IAM Roles, GCP Workload Identity).
Experience with Kubernetes, Terraform or other infrastructure as code, and AWS and/or GCP IAM.
Track record of building internal platforms or paved paths that other engineers chose to adopt, with a strong focus on developer experience.
Experience running highly available, no-downtime services with mature on-call practices.
Clear verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to drive adoption across engineering teams.

We are leaders - Leadership is not limited to our management team. It's something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies.

Our team develops and operates the critical traffic infrastructure that powers communication between thousands of services across multiple regions, as well as the ingress systems that handle external traffic entering the DoorDash platform.
You will work on core components of our traffic stack, including the Envoy Data Plane, xDS control planes and proxyless architecture. Experience with Programming Languages like Go, C++, Python or Rust
Experience with AWS and Kubernetes
Background working on and debugging high-QPS or latency-sensitive systems
You are curious, independent, ambitious, and can find solutions and make progress in an ambiguous and challenging environment

We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.
The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

To support our continued global expansion and enhance our ocean freight operations, we are seeking a Manager of Regional Ocean Management to oversee a multi-million dollar Ocean P&L for their district. This role is crucial for scaling volume, increasing yield, and driving profitability through expert market knowledge and strategic interfacing with customers. The position requires designing tailored products, managing tenders and RFQs, and collaborating with procurement and pricing teams to identify growth opportunities. By improving operational and financial processes and leveraging data for decision-making, the Manager will ensure financial health and drive the growth of the book of business.
You will:
Manage a sizeable Ocean P&L for your district through scaling volume and increasing yield
Be the market expert and support the commercial organization with market-specific intelligence, trade idiosyncrasies, and directly interfacing with customer
Help design products and generate customized go-to-market strategies for customers

Use data to drive decisions

Join on a regular basis client calls
Drive all financial health levers for your district including quoting, invoicing, and dispute escalation
Develop your team to create the future of Flexport district management
Work across Procurement, Pricing, Planning, and District Management teams to deliver globally optimized results to the Ocean P&L

5+ years of prior Ocean Freight experience at a top freight forwarder or carrier or 5+ years of supply chain experience and a BA/BS Degree;
Strategic vision and ground floor execution;
Bias to Action, Process, Structure and Data;
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills;
An obsession with client happiness. You succeed when they succeed;

The desire to lead, train, and develop up-and-coming talent in the future

title: Director, Distribution & Transportation
description:
Fortune Brands Innovations (NYSE: FBIN) is an industry-leading home, security and digital products company with a portfolio of trusted brands, including Moen, House of Rohl, Therma-Tru, Larson, Master Lock, Yale residential, and Sentry Safe.
We are building a company that is determined to win, and we are clear about how: strong brands, great people, and disciplined execution.
You'll join a team that puts customers first, keeps its commitments, and cuts through complexity to deliver meaningful results.
If you're looking for an opportunity to make an impact and help shape what's next for our iconic brands, we'd love to meet you. Apply now.
Explore life at Fortune Brands here .
Getting the right product to the right place — on time, complete and undamaged — is how we keep our promises to customers. As Director, Distribution & Transportation for our Security business, you'll own the strategy behind that promise: the multi-site distribution network, the carrier partnerships, and the long-term direction of how we move product.
This is a seat with real scope. You'll lead the team that runs the network, sit at the table with commercial and operations leaders, and own the service performance our customers feel every day.
Position location – This will be a hybrid-based position within driving distance of the following location: Deerfield, IL. (Flexibility to work from home Mondays and Fridays.)
RESPONSIBLIITIES:
Establish and execute the distribution, transportation, and network strategy for the Security business, aligning logistics capabilities with growth objectives, customer expectations, and operational requirements.
Lead a multi-site distribution network, ensuring safe, efficient, and cost-effective operations across all facilities.
Own end-to-end transportation strategy, including carrier selection, contract negotiations, rate management, and ongoing performance oversight.
Develop and optimize the transportation and distribution network to improve service levels, reduce costs, enhance scalability, and support evolving business needs.
Deliver best-in-class customer service performance through reliable on-time, in-full, and damage-free delivery execution.
Partner closely with Commercial, Operations, Manufacturing, Customer Service, Procurement, and Supply Chain leadership to drive cross-functional initiatives and business results.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) including service, cost, inventory flow, transportation efficiency, carrier performance, and warehouse productivity.
Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives leveraging Lean, Six Sigma, and supply chain best practices to drive operational excellence.
Lead annual logistics and transportation planning processes, including budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation.
Manage third-party logistics providers (3PLs), warehouse partners, and transportation vendors to ensure performance expectations and contractual obligations are met.
Evaluate emerging technologies, systems, and automation opportunities that enhance visibility, productivity, and customer experience across the distribution network.
Build, develop, and mentor a high-performing team, creating organizational capability, succession plans, and career development opportunities.
Ensure compliance with all applicable transportation, safety, regulatory, and environmental requirements.
Provide executive-level reporting and recommendations regarding network performance, strategic opportunities, risks, and investment priorities.
Set the distribution and logistics strategy for the Outdoors business and shape its long-term direction.
10+ years of leadership experience across transportation, logistics or supply chain.
A bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Finance, Business Administration, Marketing or a related field — or equivalent experience. MBA preferred.
Demonstrated success leading a multi-site distribution network.
Experience managing carrier relationships, including negotiations and performance management.
A track record of leading teams, influencing stakeholders and driving cross-functional initiatives.
Accountability for service metrics — on-time, in-full and damage-free delivery.
Willingness and ability to travel up to 30%.

title: Lead Inspector & Stacker
description:
YOUR ROLE
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
Lead and support production team members to meet daily manufacturing targets.
Communicate shift goals, updates, and expectations clearly to team members.
Serve as a role model for attendance, performance, and workplace behavior.
Support shift handoffs by communicating key updates and issues to maintenance or supervisors.
Inspect boards and ensure visual and dimensional quality standards are met.
Use QA inspection tools to measure the quality of products.
Follow QA standards to ensure we are producing a quality product.
Provide proper training for all new end of line associates.
Monitor and provide coaching and feedback regarding work performance of end of line associates.
Communicate with extruder operators to ensure a quality end product.
Review work order and ensure correct tags and color.
Manage line documentation.
Ensure packaging specification are met.
Ensure clean and organized work areas are maintained in accordance with 6S and housekeeping standards.
Adheres to Fiberon’s safety requirements.
Assist with managing the production floor (breaks, absences, etc.)
WORK ENVIRONMENT
Manufacturing environment with exposure to: Heat, noise, dust, and moving machinery
May require availability outside of standard hours to support troubleshooting or continuous operations.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
Strength & Endurance Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull objects weighing between 20 to 50 pounds independently (over 50 pounds with buddy lift), including cleaning equipment, dust collection systems, and raw materials.
Perform repetitive tasks such as sweeping, brushing, vacuuming, and operating tools like staple guns and banders.
Stand and walk for extended periods (8 to 12-hour shifts) during production and cleaning tasks.
Maintain stamina and focus to perform physically demanding tasks without fatigue.
Mobility & Flexibility Bend, squat, stoop, kneel, crawl, and stretch to reach and clean various areas, inspect equipment, and align materials.
Climb ladders and work at heights to access dust accumulation and perform maintenance tasks.
Reach or work above shoulder level as needed.
Dexterity & Coordination Use hand tools such as brushes, brooms, scrapers, and vacuums with precision and good hand-eye coordination.
Handle packaging materials, attach labels, and refill equipment accurately and efficiently.
Visual & Sensory Acuity Good vision required to identify dust accumulation, inspect product quality, and monitor screens and labels.
Ability to perform color and defect inspections with close attention to detail.
Maintain balance and spatial awareness to ensure safety and stability in a dynamic environment.

If you're ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you'll find your purpose here.
Primary Function of Position
As a Senior Manager of Clinical Affairs, this role is responsible for contributing to clinical strategies and overseeing study execution for emerging technologies across various specialties.  Clinical trials in this portfolio may be both in the US and global and include first-human-use and pivotal clinical trials targeted for regulatory submission.  This role will oversee and manages clinical protocols and other key study documents in support of regulatory submissions; manage clinical publications and evidence dissemination strategy, oversee manage communications with clinical trial sites, CROs, KOLs and medical societies; grow, develop and manage team to interface and support all clinical requirements of the company with the applicable guidelines and regulations; foresee challenges and develops critical concepts and methodologies to overcome those.  As a functional manager, this role will also lead a team of clinical operations personnel, such as clinical study managers and clinical research associates and play a key role in their development.
As a key cross-functional constituent, this employee will work closely with functions across the organization – Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Program Management Office (PMO), Clinical Research Engineering (CRE), Clinical Research Managers, Global Access Value Economics (GAVE), Global Public Affairs (GPA), Regulatory Compliance, Training, Legal, and commercial functions to optimize clinical study strategies to meet business objectives.
Roles and Responsibilities
Play a key role in the development of company’s strategy for clinical studies to meet business goals and objectives. Collaborate with internal stakeholders and KOLs to develop and review study concepts, protocol and study outlines and subsequently driving identified initiatives
Acting as a key strategic partner to Regulatory Affairs to support regulatory approval of new products and contribute to clinical sections of regulatory submissions
Responsible for managing resource and study budget to ensure clinical studies are conducted on schedule and within budget while ensuring high quality and compliance
Build strong and sustaining relationship with investigational sites and investigators for ongoing and future studies
Work closely with data management to provide guidance on development of case report form (CRF), data cleaning to ensure collection of high-quality data
Work closely with Biostats in study design, developing statistical analysis plan (SAP), analysis, interpretation and synthesis to develop Clinical Study Report and /or support development of scientific publications
Ensure compliance with corporate (e.g., SOP’s) and regulatory requirements (e.g., GCP and US FDA regulations and guidelines) and responsible for ongoing review of departmental procedures and process improvement initiatives
Responsible for setting up effective goals that are meaningful to the department and impactful to the organization
Provide functional manager leadership to direct reports and provide ongoing guidance for the assigned team members in their internal/external communication and support direct reports in consistently achieving their goals and objectives
Sets and hold individual and team accountable for high standard of competencies and overall performance
Effectively distills complexity and provides clear and actionable direction and information, help team prioritize, solve complex problems that enable the team to make significant progress
Develop talents, build a highly capable and effective team of clinical study managers (CSM) and clinical research associates (CRA) to efficiently manage clinical studies
Qualifications
Skill/Job Requirements
Minimum Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in scientific field/MD/ PhD with 12+ years of professional experience and at least 3-5 years of supervisory experience is preferred
Minimum of 5 years of experience independently managing clinical studies through different study phases (pre-IDE, IDE submission, site selection and activation, study execution, data analysis and study report, and closeout)
Excellent clinical operation and project management skills, with strong experience collaborating or leading a cross-functional team
Proven track record of strong cross-functional and key opinion leader management
Strong experience with clinical study resources and budget management
Strong experience supporting development of scientific and regulatory strategies for clinical studies
Strong experience in developing study protocol and other study documents, conducting literature review, writing clinical section for regulatory submission
Strong knowledge of 21 CFR part 812 , Good Clinical Practice, ISO14155 and other regulations/guidelines.
Basic understanding of statistics, statistical methods, and design of experiment
Previous experience supporting internal and external audit on clinical studies is preferred
Excellent ability to interact with physicians and other professionals inside and outside the company
Comfortable in a hospital environment, with experience working with nurses and surgeons; existing or previous experience/familiarity with surgery/surgical technology is preferred
Strong communication, presentation  and interpersonal skills with high attention to detail and organization
Results-driven attitude and strong problem solving skills, consistently shows dedication or strong work-ethic to help meet aggressive timelines or multiple projects when necessary
Must be able to travel up to 30-40%

The mission of Supplier Engineering is to ensure high quality and stable delivery of purchased production components from suppliers operating under robust quality systems . Each supplier engineer is responsible for ensuring suppliers meet ISI requirements for product quality, cost, and service.

Part Qualification
Support Value Engineering and Quality Improvement Part Qualification efforts
Lead Core Product Teams in defining appropriate Part Qualification requirements This includes defining testing and inspection requirements prior to system integration to maximize ISI factory efficiency
Support transfer of parts between suppliers

Work cross-functionally to improve supplier engineering processes

Evaluate new supplies through informal assessments and formal assessment by supporting lead auditors in QMS evaluations

Primary Function of Position
The PMC Technician 3 works under general direction, follows applicable department procedures and follows oral and written instruction. This position requires a highly motivated team player to ensure Equipment, Fixture and Tooling are calibrated before their due date, according to current SOP, and to ensure any Equipment, Fixture or Tooling are available for manufacturing or inspection of any products manufactured on the site. This position executes Preventive Maintenance on time and according to applicable ERP systems and supports any Unplanned Maintenance in a timely manner. This position is responsible for reporting or escalating any equipment or fixture with low productivity to be evaluated or fixed, and any repair not covered by PMC documentation or work instructions.
Essential Job Duties
Follow all corporate, safety, and production procedures and regulations.
Maintain excellent attendance in accordance with Quality Operations guidelines.
Complete ISU and other required training courses on time.
Perform other duties as assigned, in compliance with performance targets set by department.
Record test logs or write daily activity reports as required
Escalate safety, quality or other issues with supervisor or manager as needed.
Perform routine inspections, lubrication, adjustments, and repairs on machinery to prevent breakdowns per work instructions and with appropriate tooling or fixtures as indicated by procedure.
Performs PM or Calibration before it expires (due date) including any top-level EFT and peripheral assets of such EFTs, and inputs results in the ERP/SAP system.
Record completed work on assets in ERP/ SAP and update the expiration date label on the asset for any EFT after PM or Calibration is performed.

description:

Primary Function of Position
We are looking for a hands-on leader to invest in and to grow our material handling team to the next level. This includes coaching, encouraging and empowering the team as well as working side-by-side with them in a cold chain environment. Key team tasks and metrics include receiving, put away, picking, material supply and inventory accuracy. This position is responsible for oversight of personnel, administration of the raw material and sub-assembly warehouse operations, 5S + safety, inventory accuracy, and internal material replenishment processes. There is a strong focus on continuous improvement in the role.
Essential Job Duties
Hire, train, develop, and motivate warehouse personnel to follow procedures, meet high level quality standards, production schedules, operations dept goals, and productivity requirements.
Make sure current processes are properly documented and drive process improvement and simplification.
Ensure freezers, dry goods warehouse, and work area are maintained to 5S standards and FIFO is adhered to with all material movements.
Continuously perform gap analysis on documents related to warehouse operations such as SOP, DOP, WI, VA, and update as required
Work with Inventory Control to analyze and correct issues related to storage quantities and inventory discrepancies.
Provide vision and direction to team and drive training to Lean Material flow practices.
Ensure that optimal inventory levels of commodities are maintained to meet production requirements.
Ensure that company procedures, including APHIS requirements, are understood and adhered to.
Responsible for managing employee training record completion and status.
Evaluate and provide annual performance feedback to direct reports along with interim counseling to ensure performance criteria are being met.
Implement Short-Term Problem Containment and Long-Term Corrective Action for warehouse issues.
Drive continuous improvement of current systems and processes and work closely with production planning and management to optimize the value stream opportunities.
Required Skills and Experience
Minimum AA, BS degree or equivalent experience.
Minimum of three years of experience in managing warehouse activities and material flow in a manufacturing environment.
Significant computer experience including MS Office products and ERP systems, preferably SAP and Agile.
Proven track record of being an effective people leader and leading/growing highly functional teams.
Demonstrated knowledge of Kanban systems and other Lean material flow practices.
Ability to provide positive direction by encouraging peers to have a commitment to high standards of quality and performance.
Ability to handle multiple tasks and projects successfully.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Effectively manages task breakdown, helps keep individual contributors on task, player-coach, ability to step in and perform hard tasks.
Knowledge of inventory control systems, processes, and root cause analysis.
Expert knowledge of safety requirements and material handling equipment operation.
Working Conditions
Ability to lift and carry up to 35 lbs.
Preferred Skills and Experience
Bachelor’s degree
5+ years of supervisory experience
Experience supervising teams of technician/material handler level employees
Experience in the medical device industry (or other regulated industry) is preferred
Manufacturing Experience: 7+ years
LSS Green or Black Belt preferred
The ideal candidate will have a love for a fast-paced and multi-focused work environment
Go get it, can do attitude

title: Maintenance Manager

description:
Job Description
The Maintenance Manager leads the Davenport plant maintenance, reliability, utilities and plant engineering agenda to support safe, compliant, reliable and cost-effective operations. This leader owns the site Maintenance, Reliability & Engineering pillar within the Kraft Heinz Management System, builds technical capability, strengthens equipment ownership, and partners across plant functions to reduce losses and improve performance.
What You Will Do
Lead maintenance work in accordance with company EHS requirements, safe work practices and applicable regulatory standards, including LOTO, electrical safety, machine safety, hot work, confined space, work at height and contractor safety.
Provide leadership and governance for ammonia refrigeration and Process Safety Management activities, including mechanical integrity, Management of Change, PHA and audit action closure, procedures, training and emergency preparedness.
Ensure maintenance activities protect food safety and product quality through hygienic maintenance, foreign-material prevention, approved lubricants, sanitary design, post-maintenance release and coordination with Food Safety & Quality and Sanitation.
Own deployment and maturity of the KHMS Maintenance, Reliability & Engineering pillar, including daily performance routines, monthly pillar reviews, 90-day plans and escalation of barriers.
Maintain asset hierarchy, functional locations, asset master data and criticality rankings in the CMMS, and develop maintenance strategies based on asset criticality.
Create and govern a rolling 52-week maintenance plan and a two-week detailed schedule aligned with production windows, labor, skills, parts, tools, permits and contractor resources.
Improve preventive and proactive maintenance effectiveness and reduce reactive work using failure analysis, Pareto reviews, root-cause problem solving, troubleshooting guides and condition monitoring where justified.
Partner with Production and Sanitation on planned downtime, handoffs, start-up readiness and rapid response while maintaining long-term reliability discipline.
Support reliable operation and maintenance of utilities and facilities, including ammonia refrigeration, HVAC, compressed air, electrical distribution, water and wastewater, as assigned.
Manage maintenance projects through prioritization, design review, procurement, installation, commissioning, documentation, training and handoff to operations.
Support OT infrastructure and security controls in partnership with site and enterprise OT/IT resources.
Build and manage the annual maintenance budget and monthly forecast, review spending with Finance and take corrective action on variances.
Lead spare-parts and storeroom governance, including critical spares, min/max levels, obsolescence, cycle counts, kitting, repairable spares and stock-out reduction.
Select and manage contractors and OEMs, including scope, safety expectations, deliverables, cost controls, documentation and performance reviews.
Lead, coach and develop maintenance leaders, planners, technicians, utilities personnel and apprentices while building skills, accountability, succession and engagement in a unionized manufacturing environment.
What You Bring
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Maintenance, Reliability, Operations or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and progressively responsible experience.
Progressive leadership experience in maintenance or reliability within a high-speed manufacturing environment. Food or beverage manufacturing experience is strongly preferred.
Experience leading maintenance planning and scheduling, preventive or predictive maintenance, CMMS/SAP work management, root-cause analysis, equipment reliability and maintenance cost control.
Working knowledge of industrial mechanical, electrical, controls/automation, utilities and facility systems.
Experience leading people, contractors, budgets and cross-functional improvement work in a 24/7 manufacturing environment.
Ability to analyze operational and financial data, translate losses into action plans, communicate across organizational levels and sustain execution routines.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with ammonia refrigeration and OSHA Process Safety Management or EPA Risk Management Program requirements.
Experience with KHMS, TPM, WCM or another integrated manufacturing excellence system.
CMRP, CRL, PMP, Lean/Six Sigma, refrigeration/PSM or a related technical certification.
Experience in a unionized facility and with food-safety systems such as FSSC 22000, HACCP and GMPs.
Experience with condition monitoring, asset criticality, reliability-centered maintenance, storeroom optimization or capital project delivery.
Work Environment
Work is performed in an office and active food-manufacturing environment with machinery, wet areas, temperature variation, noise and required personal protective equipment.
The role requires frequent presence on the plant floor, including stairs, platforms, production, maintenance, utility and warehouse areas.
The role must be able to support plant needs outside normal business hours, including occasional evenings, nights, weekends, shutdowns and emergency responses.

title: Scientist, R&D - Imaging Lab
location: Glenview R&D Center, Illinois, United States of America
description:
Job Description
Job Purpose
As an Imaging Lab Scientist , you will support the development and execution of digital and physical visualization solutions that enable faster, clearer, and more confident packaging and product decisions across the Kraft Heinz North America portfolio. This role is responsible for delivering high-quality mock-ups, 3D models, 3D-printed parts, printed packaging materials, photography, and product documentation, while partnering with cross-functional teams to provide reliable, timely, and commercially relevant Imaging Lab support. The role also contributes creative problem-solving, concept translation, and innovative visualization approaches that help teams move from early ideas to actionable packaging decisions.
Essential Functions & Responsibilities
​​ ​Support execution of Imaging Lab requests by delivering digital and physical mock-ups, 3D models, and 3D-printed outputs that help teams evaluate packaging and product concepts, communicate design intent, and accelerate decision-making
​Create and produce package and label print outputs across film, carton, adhesive, and related materials to support development, visualization, and business needs
​Develop and maintain quality guides, including color and defect guides, to support consistent evaluation standards and clear visual references
​Lead photography and product documentation activities to ensure accurate, high-quality visual records for projects and internal reference needs
​Operate the Kongsberg cutting table to produce precise physical mock-ups and support efficient execution of Imaging Lab deliverables
​Serve as a trainer for Kongsberg cutting table use, helping build capability and consistency across users as needed
​Support 3D modeling and 3D printing activities to create prototypes, concept models, and visualization tools that improve project understanding and development speed
​Manage multiple requests and projects concurrently across mock-ups, printing, guides, photography, and documentation while meeting agreed timelines and quality expectations
​Partner directly with cross-functional stakeholders including R&D, Marketing, Sales, Packaging Development, and external vendors to clarify needs, translate concepts into actionable visualization solutions, and deliver fit-for-purpose outputs
​Support early-stage concept development by helping teams convert ideas into practical visual, digital, or physical outputs that improve project understanding and decision-making
​
​Contribute innovative thinking and creative problem-solving to improve mock-up approaches, workflow execution, and the overall effectiveness of Imaging Lab support
​Support improvements in request intake, workflow coordination, and execution reliability to strengthen service levels and reduce errors or rework
​Maintain organized files, production records, and documentation to support continuity, traceability, and efficient handoffs
​Support safe, organized, and effective Imaging Lab operations through proper equipment use, adherence to lab procedures, and coordination of day-to-day execution needs​​
Expected Experience & Required Skills
​​Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in  Packaging, Graphic Communications, Design, or a related technical discipline, with 2+ years of relevant experience; advanced degree is preferred.
​Experience supporting digital and physical mock-up development, 3D modeling, 3D printing, package and label printing, photography, and product documentation in a lab, studio, or technical service environment
​Working knowledge of print production processes across film, carton, adhesive, and related packaging materials
​Experience developing or supporting visual quality standards such as color guides, defect guides, or comparable reference materials
​Demonstrated ability to operate technical production equipment, including cutting and mock-up systems such as the Kongsberg cutting table
​Experience with 3D modeling and prototyping tools, and the ability to create practical models or printed outputs that support packaging visualization and concept development
​Ability to train others on equipment use and support consistent execution of lab workflows
​Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple requests, timelines, and priorities with accuracy and responsiveness
​Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work closely with cross-functional partners and external suppliers to clarify needs and translate ideas into effective visualization solutions
​Demonstrated ability to document work clearly, maintain consistency in execution, and deliver outputs with quality and timeliness
​Experience translating early-stage concepts into practical digital or physical visualization outputs that support project development and decision-making
​ Demonstrated creativity and innovation in solving visualization, mock-up, prototyping, or packaging-related challenges, with the ability to suggest new approaches that improve execution or project outcomes
​ Knowledge of packaging materials, visualization methods, mock-up production workflows, 3D printing processes, and emerging digital tools or AI-enabled creative workflows is a plus
​Willingness and ability to support hands-on lab and production activities as required ​

title: Commodity Risk & Financial Analyst
description:
Job Description:
Key Responsibilities
Commodity Risk Management, Valuation & Reporting
Execute daily commodity risk management processes, including trade validation, trade reconciliation, exposure monitoring, and risk reporting across multiple commodities and regions.
Generate and maintain commodity exposure, hedge coverage, net open position, and market risk reports for business and leadership stakeholders.
Maintain and validate commodity forecast, pricing, position, and market data to ensure integrity and consistency across systems and reports.
Partner with Commodity Price Risk Managers to evaluate hedge structures, coverage strategies, and potential financial impacts of commodity market movements.
Support liquidity forecasting and reporting related to commodity hedging activities, including cash settlement requirements, margin obligations, and derivative-related cash flows.
Financial Analysis, P&L Attribution & Business Insights
Develop and maintain financial models, dashboards, and reporting tools to quantify commodity exposures, hedging performance, market risks, and business impacts across the global Mars Snacking portfolio.
Deliver P&L attribution and cause-of-change analysis, identifying key drivers of financial performance including commodity price movements, basis changes, hedge impacts, timing effects, and market structure shifts.
Conduct scenario analysis, sensitivity modeling, and risk and opportunity assessments to evaluate financial impacts and support strategic decision-making.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and business performance reviews by translating commodity market dynamics and hedging activities into clear financial outcomes.
Prepare executive-ready reporting and insights that communicate commodity exposures, financial impacts, risks, opportunities, and mitigation strategies.
Hedge Accounting, Financial Controls & Governance
Support hedge accounting programs through documentation, monitoring, and testing of designated hedging relationships in partnership with Treasury and Technical Accounting teams.
Perform prospective and retrospective hedge effectiveness testing to ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and maximize hedge accounting effectiveness.
Maintain a strong control environment around commodity transactions, trade validation, market data governance, curve management, and financial reporting processes.
Support internal and external audits by providing valuation support, reconciliation documentation, control evidence, and commodity risk reporting.
Ensure compliance with commodity risk management policies, financial controls, and governance requirements.
Systems, Data Management & Process Improvement
Serve as a key user and business owner for commodity risk management and CTRM systems, supporting system integrity, process controls, master data governance, and end-user adoption.
Reconcile data across CTRM platforms, broker statements, ERP systems, market data providers, and financial reporting systems.
Develop and enhance reporting and analytical solutions using Excel, VBA, SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, and other technology platforms.
Identify automation opportunities and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, reporting accuracy, transparency, and controls.
Support implementation, testing, and ongoing enhancement of commodity risk management systems and technology platforms.
Planning & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with Treasury, Technical Accounting, Finance, Procurement, S&OP, Commercial Finance, and Commodity Price Risk Managers to support commodity risk management objectives.
Support demand forecast validation and volume planning processes that underpin commodity exposure and hedge management activities.
Support budgeting, forecast updates, cause-of-change reporting, and business performance reviews in collaboration with Finance Business Partners.
Provide analytical support for business planning, sourcing decisions, commodity strategy development, and financial performance management.
Build strong relationships across Treasury, Procurement, Planning, Manufacturing, Commercial, and Finance teams, providing insights and executive-ready reporting to support business decisions.
Required Experience & Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Financial Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related analytical field.
Strong understanding of global commodity markets, trading, hedging, valuation methodologies, and risk management principles.
Experience supporting commodity risk management, treasury, commodity trading, market risk, financial planning, product control, or commodity finance organizations.
Experience developing financial models that combine commodity pricing, sourcing assumptions, exposure forecasts, hedge results, and business drivers to assess P&L impacts.
Experience with commodity exposure reporting, Mark-to-Market valuation, trade reconciliation, hedge effectiveness testing, financial controls, and P&L attribution analysis.
Advanced analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets and deliver actionable insights.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with SQL, Python, VBA, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytical and reporting tools.
Experience with CTRM systems, ERP platforms, financial reporting systems, and market data providers preferred.

Our staged transition toward a world-class maintenance program to support our operations will provide you with the opportunity to help install and maintain our physical assets, and then adopt and implement reliability programs to sustain their operational excellence.  All maintenance roles offer high-visibility and high-impact opportunities.  Proven maintenance leaders, experienced outside contractors, and a high-performing, tenured team of technicians will support your success onsite.

Provides input to managing the controls and automation systems testing, quality control, data retrieval and training for packaging and processing equipment.

Assists with the development and modification of PLC & HMI programs.
Provides project engineering support to process areas.
Provides controls support for the manufacturing facility and assist plant mechanics in troubleshooting.
Ensures documentation for control/electrical system and document change control procedures.
Assists with the development and management of controls related capital projects.
Contributes to determination and maintainability of new process control systems and manage process controls change control procedures for existing equipment.
You’ll work around moving machines – mixers, conveyor belts, and forklifts.
Knowledge, skills and Education:
All candidates, however, should have understanding in automated industrial machinery, which includes motors, servos, pumps, drives, relays, etc. and hydraulic and pneumatic systems; packaging, conveyance, liquid and powder manufacturing equipment and processes; PLC trouble shooting; electrical and mechanical drawings; installation and troubleshoot basic three phase motor control circuits; and breakdown analysis as well as the following:
Ability and skills to troubleshoot and maintain Allen-Bradley MicroLogix and ControlLogix hardware
Perform Allen-Bradley PLC programming implementing RSLogix5, RSLogix500 and RSLogix5000 software or equivalent.
Implement and troubleshoot industrial communication networks including Ethernet, Allen-Bradley Remote I/O and DeviceNet communication networks
Read electrical schematics, Process & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&ID’s) and Process Flow Diagrams (PFD’s)
Perform PID Loop tuning and implement instrument calibration procedures.
Knowledge of programming languages relevant to PLCs.
Install, maintain, and troubleshoot electrical control systems, including PLC controls, networking, and HMI systems.
Initiate and develop control system modifications and new projects to improve plant performance and reliability.
General knowledge of the National Electrical Code
Knowledge of Wiring, Hydraulic Systems, and Pneumatic Systems.
Reading blueprints and schematics.

title: Data Center Technician Manager
description:
Overview
As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT) Manager, you will lead a team of technicians, providing expert guidance on performing hardware deployments, diagnostics on equipment, and hardware decommissions. You will support technician performance, prioritizing technician tasks while monitoring Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).  This opportunity will allow you to model leadership principles, provide training to technicians, and accelerate your career growth in the process.
Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT Manager, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.
Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 data centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
In this environment, you may be asked to go on business travel to support other metros periodically, 0-25% of the time and have the ability to work 12-hour shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends and/or holidays.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Overview
We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer who lives and breathes Azure Cosmos DB and knows how it is implemented underneath. Your mission is to make throttling disappear from Microsoft's AI plugin registry with fast, surgical, high-ROI changes. Success is objective: throttling goes away, reliability goes up, and latency goes down, even as scale grows. You will see the results in days, not quarters.
We are the Agent Tools and Lifecycle team in Microsoft's Copilot, Agents and Platform (CAP) organization. We build the service behind the AI plugin registry. Admins use it in the Microsoft 365 admin center to govern the plugins (skills, connectors, and agents) that extend Microsoft Copilot, and users discover and use those plugins across products such as Copilot Chat, Cowork, Teams, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. The registry is a core part of Microsoft's AI architecture, alongside Work IQ, and Copilot experiences across Microsoft depend on it. If you use an AI solution from Microsoft, you likely are working with our service. Come join us at the center of AI transformation at Microsoft!
As a hands-on individual contributor, you will be the technical leader for the AI plugin registry's Azure Cosmos DB tier. Our catalog of plugins and agents, and the entitlements and policies that decide who can use them, live in Cosmos DB in data centers worldwide, including sovereign clouds. Traffic keeps growing as the registry expands to experiences such as Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, and Microsoft Foundry. Experience working on the internals of Cosmos DB or a comparable database, such as MongoDB, Amazon DynamoDB, or Apache Cassandra, and an understanding of the hardware and network limits that make them throttle, are especially valuable. Our global reach means 24/7 on-call service.
This position is based in Redmond, Washington and requires the employee be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Cut request unit (RU) consumption to make throttling go away, fast. Start with the queries that use the most RUs, where we see room for 50–90% reductions: turn cross-partition and fan-out queries into point reads from Cosmos DB or Azure Blob Storage, batched reads, or single-partition queries, and tune indexes.
Pick work by return on investment. Ship several targeted fixes in parallel, each within days, and measure each one in production. Take on a larger redesign only when the data shows smaller fixes cannot get there, and deliver it in steps that each pay off.
Fix hot partitions and size limits at the source: partition keys, document design, indexing policies, and API contracts that give high-traffic calls the keys they need for point reads. When data has to move, migrate it with zero downtime across all environments, including sovereign clouds.
Decide what belongs in Cosmos DB. Move large, binary, unbounded, or rarely queried content to Azure Blob Storage or other storage, weighing latency, availability, and data-residency needs.
Remove redundant and sequential database calls on our busiest paths with batching, request coalescing, and caching, and use retry budgets, load shedding, and graceful degradation so database pressure does not turn into failed requests.
Work with product management and the teams that call us to give each caller a throttling budget. Find callers that request the same unchanged data again and again, help them cache on their side, and lower the budgets of the heaviest callers over time.
Make success measurable: own the telemetry, dashboards, and alerts, RU use per API and per caller, partition skew, availability, and latency. Set targets, show the effect of every change, and spot limits before we hit them.
Raise the bar through AI: write AI skills that review designs and code for Cosmos DB mistakes, find high-RU queries, and show engineers how to fix them, so your expertise scales across the team. Use agentic tools to build and validate fixes faster, following Responsible AI practices. Mentor engineers and represent us with the Azure Cosmos DB product group.
Serve as a Designated Responsible Individual (DRI) in our 24/7 on-call rotation, lead data-tier incident response, and turn what we learn into lasting fixes.

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.

OR equivalent experience.
4+ years of experience building or operating large-scale distributed databases, such as Azure Cosmos DB, MongoDB, Amazon DynamoDB, or Apache Cassandra, including partitioning, indexing, and query performance.

Proficiency in C# and .NET, and experience with Azure services such as Azure Functions, Service Bus, Azure Cache for Redis, and API (application programming interface) Management.

Lead the portfolio operating layer for Foundational Offers across enterprise and mission-critical services. You will connect portfolio economics, pricing, delivery capacity, engineering priorities and investment returns so that leaders can make coherent decisions across the full support and services ladder.
Working as a peer to offer program leaders, you will establish shared operating models and turn competing business needs into defensible portfolio choices. Success is measured by decisions changed: pricing revised to protect differentiated customer value, engineering priorities sharpened and capacity assumptions corrected before funding.
